summary.text: Merrillee Malwitz-Jipson is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 10 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent that also includes Republican Marshall Rawson and write-in candidate James Batley.

paragraphs.text: Malwitz-Jipson advanced from the Democratic primary without appearing on the ballot after the August 18, 2026 primary was canceled.
